summary: Enhance your skills with our NoSQL Databases Training Course. Learn key concepts and practical applications to excel in modern data management.
lede: NoSQL database training helps application developers, data engineers, database administrators, and solution architects match data models to workload access patterns. Through guided exercises, they model documents, design queries and indexes, choose partition keys, and assess consistency and replication trade-offs across document, key-value, wide-column, and graph databases. They also practise monitoring, backup and recovery checks, security reviews, and building an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technology professionals who work with application data, distributed systems, or database decisions and need a structured foundation through intermediate capability. It suits professionals moving from relational database environments as well as teams standardizing NoSQL practices across products.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic database concepts, SQL familiarity, and exposure to application or data workflows. You should be comfortable reading simple JSON and discussing tables, keys, queries, and transactions. No prior NoSQL administration is required. Coding requirement: No production programming is required. You will use guided command-line queries and configuration exercises with mongosh, Redis CLI, cqlsh, Cypher, and DynamoDB examples. Basic scripting familiarity helps but remains optional.
